reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V4 combo (understeer K_us=1.559e-5 from out/fit.txt, then per-segment bias removal, then per-segment integer-sample lag alignment in ±15 samples) on each canonical Ford segment.
notes: V4 model: per-segment lag fitted on each canonical segment (matching agent's procedure); K_us=1.559e-5 from agent's out/fit.txt; ran across both Mach-E and F-150 Lightning even though agent only scored Mach-E; of 545 globbed segments, 521 contributed samples (24 had all v_mps<=2.0).
